analysis.reasonEn: The upward trend has been maintained for 4 consecutive sessions since the last buy signal. RSI has exited oversold territory and entered the neutral zone, with the MACD histogram showing improvement. While ADX indicates a clear trend at 29.2, the directionality remains uncertain as +DI is lower than -DI. The 52-week position at 32.3% is still at a low level. With the target allocation of 1x filled, leverage entry could be considered, but the current price is approaching the swing resistance ($56.73), requiring confirmation of further upside potential.
